en-US.name: Follow Builders
en-US.summary: Tracks top AI builders across podcasts, X/Twitter and company blogs, delivering curated daily or weekly digests. Depends on a third-party public feed; Telegram or mail delivery requires separate setup and explicit authorization.

zh-CN.name: Follow Builders
zh-CN.summary: 追踪 AI 领域真正在造东西的开发者、研究者与创始人，把播客、X/Twitter 与官方博客的动态汇成每日/每周摘要推送。依赖第三方公共信源；Telegram 或邮件推送须自行配置并明确授权。

requirements.value: Access to the upstream public digest feed. Feed availability and data licensing are governed by its operator.
Node.js is required by the included digest and delivery scripts. Optional Telegram/email delivery requires the operator's own account credentials and explicit sending/scheduling authorization.
